caption: The drawing features a central composition with a light beige background enclosed by a thin rectangular brown border. At the center of the artwork, there is a single pink hand with fingers upright and together, with a blue cuff at the wrist. The hand is positioned over and partially covering a large, stylized red heart with two rounded lobes. In each corner of the bordered area, there is an identical decorative motif composed of a curved, peach-colored shape interlocking with a green, crescent-shaped form, both pointed inward toward the center. Beneath the hand and heart, near the bottom-center of the drawing, there is a line of red cursive text reading "Liebes Lied."
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Piece)
